methodology.purpose: Rank underdogs on a transparent 25-point directional football rubric and explain the actual upset mechanism.

routing.intermediate: all other current underdogs; calibration only

methodology.scoring: Only evidence that directionally helps the underdog earns qualitative points. Compression is total-based. Production and Independent Football support are directional. Every candidate receives an Upset Case, Why It Could Fail and Key Things to Watch.
validationPlan: compare outright win rate to market-implied probability within price buckets
track Brier/log loss when executable ML exists
promote no component into production without holdout validation

narrative.upsetCase: UConn has an upset path built around a credible quarterback/passing path, enough trench resistance to avoid a one-sided game, an explosive-play matchup path. Produced 671 yards in a 56-7 win with Kalieb Osborne contributing as passer and runner, but 10 penalties for 134 yards and opponent quality temper the upgrade.
narrative.whyItCouldFail: The case can fail if the favorite’s talent and depth advantages dominate the matchup.
keyThingsToWatch: UConn QB efficiency and early-down success
evidence: Produced 671 yards in a 56-7 win with Kalieb Osborne contributing as passer and runner, but 10 penalties for 134 yards and opponent quality temper the upgrade.
Canonical selected-week market: UConn +3.5, total 51.5; production model Lean UConn edge 1.022060871376623; Football Independent UConn edge 1.3701014522943722.
